# Lab 21.4: Idle Slot Sharing & Predictability

## What We Are Going to Do
Configure two reservations that share idle slots, then cap one so its cost and performance stay predictable.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create two reservations with baseline slots.** Baseline slots are billed every hour, so finish this lab quickly.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=ENTERPRISE --slots=50 --ignore_idle_slots=false lab-a
bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=ENTERPRISE --slots=50 --ignore_idle_slots=false lab-b</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Understand idle sharing.** With `ignore_idle_slots=false`, if `lab-a` is idle, `lab-b` can borrow its 50 slots for free. Open each reservation in **Workload management** to see the setting.

3. **[CLI] Turn sharing off for one.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq update --reservation --location=US --ignore_idle_slots=true lab-b
bq show --reservation --location=US lab-b</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Now `lab-b` uses only its own slots, even if `lab-a` is idle.

4. **[Console] Set a maximum size.** Edit `lab-a` and set a **maximum reservation size** (baseline + autoscale + borrowed idle slots). This keeps its performance and cost within known limits.

5. **[Console] Fair scheduling.** Inside one reservation, slots are shared fairly between projects first, then between jobs. Read this in the reservation details panel.

6. **[CLI] Delete both reservations.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-a
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-b</span>
</code></pre>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Idle sharing | Unused baseline slots lent to others |
| `ignore_idle_slots` | Opt out of borrowing |
| Maximum size | Predictable upper limit |
| Fairness | Projects first, then jobs |
